context: Five men golf together for the first time as a regular gathering.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 皆さん、五人で、ゴルフ、できるって、贅沢ですね。
lines.en: All five of us golfing together — that's quite a luxury.
lines.style: Warm opening, genuine appreciation in the attack. Measured pace, quiet authority softening into real pleasure. Slight lift on 'luxury' — not showy, just authentic recognition of something good.

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.jp: 田舎から、わざわざ来てくれて、ほんま、嬉しい。
lines.en: Coming all this way from the country — truly makes me happy.
lines.style: Gruff affection on the opening. Sincere and direct, no flourish. Slow, deliberate pace. The warmth is in the steadiness, not in the performance.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 皆さんと、こうやって、過ごせるの、本当に、ありがたい。
lines.en: Being able to spend time like this with everyone — I'm really grateful.
lines.style: Kansai warmth throughout — slight regional lilt on the opening. Soft and genuine, not loud. Pace lingers on 'grateful' as if really sitting with the feeling. Thread of real affection under every word.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: 世代も、業界も、超えて、五人で、本当に。
lines.en: Across different generations, different industries — five of us here — it's really something.
lines.style: Tender and reflective, like he's pausing to notice something he doesn't usually say out loud. Quiet wonder underneath. Soft attack, slow thoughtful pace. Trails off slightly on 'something' — the feeling is bigger than the words.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: こんな、ご縁、本当に、人生で、なかなか、ない。
lines.en: A connection like this — it's rare in life.
lines.style: Formal warmth, composed but sincere. Gentle opening attack. Moderate pace, slightly lingering on 'rare' — acknowledging the weight of it. Real depth underneath the professional tone.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 田中部長と呼ばれてた頃から、ずっと、皆さんに、支えられて。
lines.en: Since the days when I was called Tanaka-bucho, I've always been supported by all of you.
lines.style: Quiet reflection. Gentle authority in the voice, but humble underneath. Opens softly, then settles into something almost fragile — admitting dependence. Slow deliberate pace. Warmth through composure.

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.jp: こちらこそ、皆さんに、ずっと、お世話に。
lines.en: Same here — I've been indebted to all of you for so long.
lines.style: Direct and gruff, but the warmth is unmissable. Short, genuine phrases. Slow delivery, steady as breath. No apology in the gratitude, just real weight and real feeling.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: ひかりちゃんも、いつか、ご一緒できたら、ええなあ。
lines.en: Hikari too — if she could join us someday, that'd be something.
lines.style: Kansai affection — slight warmth in the regional swing. Soft wishing quality on 'someday.' Not loud or performative, just genuine hope. Pace is easy, imagining it. Real tenderness for the next generation.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: 次世代、繋いでいきたいですね。
lines.en: I'd like us to pass this on to the next generation.
lines.style: Soft and philosophical, almost gentle. Quiet determination underneath — this matters. Slow pace, each word deliberate. Closes with slight warmth, like setting something down carefully for someone else to pick up.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: こうやって、五人で、ずっと、続けていきたい。
lines.en: Like this — the five of us — I want to keep going forever.
lines.style: Formal sincerity with real tenderness underneath. Opens measured, then softens on 'keep going.' Slight catch of emotion — not performed, just real. Pace slows slightly at the end. Closing with quiet determination.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: そうしましょう。長い、お付き合い、お願いします。
lines.en: Let's do that. A long association — I'm asking for your continued friendship.
lines.style: Composed and authoritative, but the warmth is genuine. Opens with quiet conviction. Pace is slow and deliberate. The request at the end carries real weight — not a formality, but a real ask. Closes with soft composure.

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.jp: 感謝、本当に、感謝してる。
lines.style: Gruff and direct, almost sparse. Short phrase, then a beat, then repetition — emphasizing the sincerity through simplicity. Slow and steady. The warmth is in the repetition itself, not in any flourish. Closes quietly.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 人生、こんなええ友達、出会えて、本当に、運がええ。
lines.en: In life, meeting friends this good — I'm truly lucky.
lines.style: Kansai warmth with a philosophical note. Slow opening, then slight brightening on 'lucky.' Regional swing threads through. Genuine wonder — not boasting, just real gratitude for good fortune. Warm and full-hearted throughout.
